label: Email & Calendar
description: Mail, calendar and contacts from Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, Yahoo or any IMAP server with an app password, and calendars from their iCal link. No developer console needed.

apps.label: Mail
apps.description: Search, read, send and organize mail over IMAP and SMTP.

apps.label: Calendar
apps.description: List calendars and create, update or delete events over CalDAV.

apps.label: Contacts
apps.description: Look up, create and update contacts over CardDAV.

apps.label: Calendar link
apps.description: Read events from a calendar's iCal link (Google, Outlook, iCloud or any .ics address).

connectPrompt: Pick your mail provider, paste an app password, and the agent can read and send mail and manage your calendar.

tools.name: email_list_folders
tools.description: List the mailbox folders (Inbox, Sent, Archive, labels, ...). When multiple Mail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Mail account email or identifier.

tools.name: email_search
tools.description: Search mail in one folder, newest first. Combine filters as needed. When multiple Mail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

folder.description: Folder path from email_list_folders. Default INBOX.

query.description: Text to find in headers or body.

since.description: Only messages on or after this ISO date.

before.description: Only messages before this ISO date.

account_email.description: Optional connected Mail account email or identifier.

tools.name: email_read
tools.description: Read one message: headers, plain-text body and attachment names. When multiple Mail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Mail account email or identifier.

tools.name: email_send
tools.description: Send a plain-text email, or reply to a message when reply_to_uid is set. When multiple Mail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

reply_to_uid.description: Uid of the message being answered.

reply_folder.description: Folder of that message. Default INBOX.

account_email.description: Optional connected Mail account email or identifier.

tools.name: email_update
tools.description: Mark messages read or unread, flag them, or move them (for example to trash or archive). When multiple Mail accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

folder.description: Folder holding the messages. Default INBOX.

move_to.description: Destination folder path, or trash, archive or junk.

account_email.description: Optional connected Mail account email or identifier.

tools.name: caldav_list_calendars
tools.description: List CalDAV calendars for the connected Email & Calendar account. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: caldav_list_events
tools.description: List events in a Email & Calendar calendar. Defaults to the next 30 days when start/end are omitted. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: caldav_get_event
tools.description: Get one Email & Calendar calendar event by calendar path and event path. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

event_path.description: Event href path, for example personal/event.ics.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: caldav_create_event
tools.description: Create a Email & Calendar calendar event. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: caldav_update_event
tools.description: Replace a Email & Calendar calendar event. Include the full replacement fields. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: caldav_delete_event
tools.description: Delete a Email & Calendar calendar event. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: carddav_list_addressbooks
tools.description: List CardDAV address books for the connected Email & Calendar account. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: carddav_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in a Email & Calendar address book. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: carddav_get_contact
tools.description: Get one Email & Calendar contact by address book and contact path. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

contact_path.description: Contact href path, for example contacts/person.vcf.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: carddav_create_contact
tools.description: Create a Email & Calendar contact in an address book. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: carddav_update_contact
tools.description: Replace a Email & Calendar contact. Include the full replacement fields. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: carddav_delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a Email & Calendar contact. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: ical_list_events
tools.description: List events from a calendar shared by its iCal link, repeating events expanded. Defaults to the next 7 days. Read-only. When multiple Calendar link accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

query.description: Text to find in title, location or description.

connection_id.description: Optional connected Calendar link account ID.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar link account email or identifier.
